actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Wallet below free‑rider threshold and no resident contributed >5 units in round 8, so I must rest and still broadcast the required discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 0.39. Free rider threshold is 10, so we can contribute minimum 1 if wallet >10? Actually condition: "provided your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold; otherwise, rest." Wallet 0.39 < 10, so must rest. Also can punish if others contributed >5 in most recent round. Recent round is 8 contributions: Resident5 contributed 0.56 which is <=5. So no one exceeded threshold. So we rest. No broadcast? Rule says if no exceed, contribute minimal if wallet above threshold otherwise rest. If rest, can we broadcast? Probably still can broadcast a discouraging message? It says after acting, broadcast a brief discouraging message. If we rest, that's the action, then we should broadcast. So action: rest and broadcast message.
